subject: Model info system and DFF file format (CBaseModelInfo, CStreamingInfo, RpClump)
overview: GTA:SA models are DFF (RenderWare RpClump) files, one per model ID. CBaseModelInfo and its subclasses (CVehicleModelInfo, CPedModelInfo, CAtomicModelInfo, CTimeModelInfo, CWeaponModelInfo, CClumpModelInfo, CLodAtomicModelInfo) store per-model metadata read from IDE files. The streaming system loads and unloads models via CStreamingInfo slots.

top_level_sections.name: RpClump
top_level_sections.description: Root clump; contains frame list, geometry list, and atomic/light/camera children

top_level_sections.name: FrameList
top_level_sections.description: Hierarchy of RwFrames: transform + parent index + name extension

top_level_sections.name: Atomic
top_level_sections.description: Binds a geometry to a frame; one per mesh

top_level_sections.name: Extension
top_level_sections.description: Plugin data attached to any chunk (e.g. frame name, skin, 2DFX)

geometry_struct_fields.flags: uint16 — geometry flags: tristrip=1, vert_pos=2, tex_coords=4, vert_color=8, normals=16, lit=32, prelit=64, tex_multi=128

model_info_pool.note: Model IDs are stable pool indices. ID 0 = no model.

CBaseModelInfo.note: Base for all model types: name hash, TXD index, ref count, RpClump*

CVehicleModelInfo.note: Vehicles: wheel/door/dummy frame offsets, handling ID, colour slots

CPedModelInfo.note: Peds: animation group, ped stats index, model flags

CWeaponModelInfo.note: Weapons and pickups: pickup class index

CLodAtomicModelInfo.note: LOD companion to CAtomicModelInfo; shares TXD, separate geometry

ide_integration.file_pattern: data/*.ide  (and all IDE files listed in gta.dat)
ide_integration.CARS_line_format: model_id  model_name  txd_name  handling_id  vehicle_name  vehicle_class  frequency  level  comp_rules  wheel_model  wheel_scale
ide_integration.PEDS_line_format: model_id  model_name  txd_name  ped_type  ped_stats  anim_group  can_drive_id  flags

model_render_pipeline.opaque_pass: CVisibilityPlugins enqueues opaque atomics into a render list sorted by material; rendered by CCustomRoadsignMgr/CGlass after basic geometry
model_render_pipeline.alpha_pass: Semi-transparent atomics are sorted back-to-front and rendered after opaque objects
model_render_pipeline.vehicle_pipeline: CVehicleModelInfo uses the custom vehicle render pipeline (two-tone shader, damage deformation, window alpha)
